title: Living Water
summary: Living water referred to fresh, flowing water, a precious image in dry lands where wells, springs, and cisterns mattered deeply.
background: Scripture uses water imagery for life, cleansing, satisfaction, the Spirit, and God’s provision. Jesus’ words about living water gain force against this background.
teachingHelp: When teaching living water, show both the physical setting and the spiritual thirst Christ alone satisfies.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
